research_question: Does lag-aware REM-AlignNet-MTL-Refine consistently outperform CW-STFT+TCN and prior REM variants on CR_RVS under 5-fold subject-independent validation?
hypothesis: The lag-aware refine configuration that succeeded on fold 01 will improve CR_RVS full-window diagnostics across all five folds while preserving the Shape-200 morphology advantage.
protocol: 5-fold subject-independent CV, CW-STFT input, no target-subject calibration.
changed_variable: Use lag-aware REMAlignMTLRefineNet configuration validated in q1_crrvs_remalign_refine_lagaware_fold01_pilot.
success_criteria: 5-fold full-window PCC exceeds CW-STFT+TCN 5-fold full-window PCC 0.4379.
5-fold RR error improves below CW-STFT+TCN 5-fold RR error 17.69 ms.
5-fold Shape-200 PCC remains above CW-STFT+TCN Shape-200 PCC 0.5503 and close to original REM Shape-200 PCC 0.8865.
If all criteria pass, mark as candidate for final CR_RVS external validation; still require metric audit before publishable=true.
checkpoint_selection: Use validation-best checkpoint per fold; no test-set checkpoint selection.
estimated_compute: Five folds, 50 epochs each, one GPU.
failure_interpretation: If fold-01 gains do not generalize, the lag-aware setting is subject/fold sensitive and should remain a diagnostic insight rather than a final model.
